note: XXIV fill shots, recipe B, the sky of 4-6 Oct 1893 · RETAKE of refused beats, 20 Nov
style: An oil painting of 1893, painted alla prima in the manner of Sargent, Atkinson Grimshaw and the Victorian narrative painters: visible loose brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin transparent glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges, broken colour, canvas weave showing through; night in early October 1893, deep shadows, warm lamplight against cold blue darkness, in the dark tone of a gothic Victorian nocturne; figures small or in silhouette, no detailed faces. Not an illustration, not digital art. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, lettering, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Shot: very wide. The open sea at night under stars, a sailing ship far off with one lantern at her stern, black swell, no moon yet.
Shot: establishing, very wide. The river Danube at night in 1893, a wide dark river between low marshy banks and distant mountains, a few lights of a town, stars.

Shot: medium-wide, no people. A bedroom at night lit by two candles on a dressing table, an oval looking-glass reflecting only the empty dark room behind, a hairbrush and a small crucifix on the table.
Shot: far, exterior. The asylum at night under stars, no moon, one upper bedroom window lit warm behind a drawn blind, bare trees and a lawn in cold blue darkness.
Shot: very wide interior from the far dark corner of a book-lined study at night: two men small at a lamplit desk, papers, the rest of the room in deep shadow.
